title: Utility Pass-Through Service Decision Table — Holding Period for a Recent Portal Bank Payment Before a Credit Refund
content:
**Rule.** When a credit balance on a final-billed Utility Pass-Through Service account is refunded, the most recent bank-account payment made through the resident portal is held back from the refund while fewer days than its holding period have passed since it was received, the days counted by subtracting the receipt date from the handling date. The holding period for the most recent bank-account payment made through the resident portal is 1 day where the lease ledger shows an automatic bank draft paid in the last six months, and 4 days where the lease ledger shows no such draft and the utility account carries no more than one bank-account payment, through the portal or by automatic draft, in the last twelve months. In any other case neither of these periods applies.

**Records read.** The lease ledger is the rent ledger of the Home-Site Lease the account served; an automatic bank draft paid there is a rent payment received through autopay. Bank-account payments on the utility account are one-time portal bank payments and automatic bank drafts, counted together. An entry is in the last six months when fewer than 6 whole months separate its date from the handling date, and in the last twelve months when fewer than 12 whole months do.

## Decision table

| Automatic bank draft on the Home-Site Lease ledger in the last 6 months | Bank-account payments on the utility account in the last 12 months | Holding period |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | any number | 1 day |
| No | 0 or 1 | 4 days |
| No | 2 or more | neither period applies |

## Days and holding (hypothetical)

| Holding period | Payment received | Days passed | Held back? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 day | on the handling date | 0 | Yes |
| 1 day | the day before | 1 | No |
| 4 days | 3 days before | 3 | Yes |
| 4 days | 4 days before | 4 | No |
